concept.title: Defogging inside windshield with the automatic climate control

defogging inside windshield with the automatic climate control

li.p: Set the fan speed to the desired position.
The outside (fresh) air position will be selected automatically and the air conditioning will turn on according to the detected ambient temperature.

conbody.p: If the air conditioning and outside (fresh) air position are not selected automatically, adjust the corresponding icon manually. If the () position is selected, lower fan speed is adjusted to a higher fan speed.
